text:
sre-alert-bot: SLO alert: hosted-infer p99 latency > 2s and 5xx fraction spike in region=usw2. Grouped by gateway. Alert id: A-3691009 :rotating_light:

mira: saw this, customers pinging support about timeouts + 502s. ETA on first look?

jon: looking at dashboards now — probing /dashboards/hosted-infer/slo/usw2. p50 fine, p95 up to 1.3s, p99 ~2.6s, 5xx fraction jumped to 3.8% in last 7m.

liam: any rollout or model change in that window? I don't see deploys in us-west-2 in the deploy-bot logs.

eva: support: two customers opened tickets 10m ago, one reports streaming cut mid-response, the other full request -> 502. Provided request id examples: r_8f3a, r_8f3c.

ken: can we surface any trace for r_8f3a? I'm getting a trace gap for that trace id in jaeger. Possible sampling miss.

sre-alert-bot: Correlation: increased token batching in proxy due to backlog + rate limiter hits. Observed throttle fallback (route -> cheap-model) triggered 11:03:12 but upstream returned 502.

mira: query I'm running (tempo/logs):
```
logs | where service == "hosted-infer-gateway" and timestamp > ago(15m)
| where status >= 500
| summarize count() by upstream_cluster, error_class
```
Results: majority 502 from upstream cluster infer-pool-03, error_class: handshake_timeout / connection_reset.

liam: infer-pool-03 nodes showing increased TCP RSTs and kernel backlog drops. Looks like ephemeral overload. CPU on those instances at 85-90% and NVMe io wait spiky.

jon: autoscaler didn't spin up because node pool reached quota, and burst capacity config didn't kick — quota error in autoscaler events: "quotaExceeded: cannot allocate more gpus".

mira: that explains fallback -> rate limiter then fallback -> cheap-model then upstream 502s when pool couldn't accept connections. So SLO burn chain: quota -> backlog -> tcp resets -> 502 -> customer impact.

eva: re: tickets, customers want repro steps. Any temporary mitigation?

ken: immediate mitigation options: 1) manually shift a small percentage of traffic to other region (us-east-1) via routing policy, 2) increase retry window/backoff in gateway for this route, 3) temporarily disable prefetching to reduce load on infer-pool-03. Which is safest?

liam: I'm for disabling prefetching for the affected model group in us-west-2 for now. That reduces arrival burst to pool without changing routing. Patch:
```
PATCH /config/routes/hosted-infer
{
  "route": "model:curie-quant-v2",
  "prefetch": false
}
```
Will push canary 2% -> 25% -> 100% if metrics look OK.

jon: I'm going to request temporary quota increase with infra team; estimated approval in 30-45m. Until then, disable prefetch can be done now.

mira: please also add an alert rule for autoscaler quota failures (we had none). Create an SLO burn playbook link.

ken: rolling the prefetch patch now to 2% canary in usw2.

sre-alert-bot: deploy started: canary 2% @ 3691010200 by ken.

mira: monitoring... p99 dropping to 1.9s within 3m, 5xx fraction down to 1.1%. Good sign.

eva: replied to both customers with temporary workaround (retry with exponential backoff 200ms -> 800ms x3) and note about ongoing mitigation.

liam: follow-ups: (a) repro script to simulate backlog to verify fallback behavior, (b) add autoscaler quota alert, (c) postmortem to inventory quota limits + burst capacity. I'm owning repro script.

jon: I'll own the alert and the quota request thread.

mira: ken please keep canary at 2% until autoscaler quota is resolved, then we can ramp. Also save packet captures from infer-pool-03 for root cause.

ken: saved tcpdump to s3://redwood-debug/3691009999/infer-pool-03.pcap and attached to internal ticket.

mira: closing loop: once quota increased or nodes relieved, we should re-enable prefetch and validate with synthetic traffic. Add a regression test for throttle->fallback->502 path in the chaos harness.

sre-alert-bot: Alert resolved at 3691010600: 5xx fraction returned below threshold for 15m.

mira: summary for postmortem: quota exhaustion prevented autoscaler from scaling, causing backlog and kernel drops on infer pool -> TCP resets -> 502s and SLO burn. Mitigation: disable prefetch (temporary), quota request, add autoscaler quota alert, add chaos/regression test, update customer comms.

jon: filing incident ticket INC-36910 and assigning owners.

eva: will follow up with customer status updates and capture any logs they can share.

liam: adding a note to model-onboarding docs: recommend prefetch limits per model per region to avoid single-pool overload.

mira: thanks team. We'll draft postmortem and link to this thread. :white_check_mark:
